About Widget Corp

Widget Corp was founded in 1998 by Ada Lovelace in Cambridge.

The company employs 4,200 people and reported revenue of $3.5 billion in 2023.

A spokesperson said, “We ship widgets to over 40 countries every year.”

Its headquarters moved to London on March 3, 2010.
